description: For \(f(x)=x+1\) and \(g(x)=2x\) on \(\mathbb R\), \((g\circ f)(x)=2x+2\) and \((f\circ g)(x)=2x+1\). Consequently, \(g\circ f\ne f\circ g\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.SetsAndMaps.composition_order_example :
  (∀ (x : ℝ), ((fun y => 2 * y) ∘ fun y => y + 1) x = 2 * x + 2) ∧
    (∀ (x : ℝ), ((fun y => y + 1) ∘ fun y => 2 * y) x = 2 * x + 1) ∧
      ((fun y => 2 * y) ∘ fun y => y + 1) ≠ (fun y => y + 1) ∘ fun y => 2 * y
